description: Article rule of docs/C3_V2_DEVELOPMENT.md section 5, applied to every article of the four Study 2 laws: keep articles that set duties for the organisation (service provider, employer, creditor) plus definitions; drop scope-only, transposition, penalties, reporting, review, amending and final provisions. Articles whose duties fall only on others (Member States, Commission, intermediaries, individual workers) set no duty for the organisation and are dropped too. The rule keeps or drops whole articles. Decided 24 Oct 2026, before any retrieval or silver labelling of the new laws.
